summary.text: Elisa Lassiter is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 40 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Kimberly New (R).
She works in nonprofit management and says she has more than two decades of experience in federal, state and local government and nonprofit organizations.

paragraphs.text: Elisa Lassiter earned a high school diploma from Frederick Douglass High School, a bachelor's degree from Georgia State University in 2005, and a graduate degree from the University of West Alabama in 2007.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has dedicated her career to connecting families and communities with the resources and opportunities they need.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
In the survey, Lassiter listed access to quality public schools, affordable health care, safe and stable housing, and economic opportunity as her campaign's main points.
She also named voting rights and disability inclusion among the policy areas she is passionate about.
